title: Relating
description: The philosophical primitive of the relationality framework: the directed act that constitutes its terms, holding including and excluding together in productive opposition rather than connecting things that already exist (ontology.ttl `rel:Relating`; content/text/glossary/terms/relating.md). Identified in the mathematical layer with predication. Root of the semiotic agents stack: relating → (communicating, knowing, playing) → animating → (socializing, computing, gaming) → organizing.

subject.description: The subject-side term the act of relating constitutes. Structurally distinct from the object-side even when the predicate's effect is symmetric — relating is directed, never symmetric by default.

object.description: The object-side term the act of relating constitutes.
